long_biography.plain_text:
Richard Westerhuis began making photographs as a teenager, fascinated by his father’s darkroom, before setting the camera aside while he built businesses. When he returned to the medium decades later, he developed staged conceptual work examining identity, vulnerability and domestic space. He builds sets and controls light in camera, using little digital manipulation.

His series Is This the Poem I Promised You? constructed abandoned-looking interiors from handmade scenery and a carefully tested colour palette. The work appeared at Unseen Photo Fair and Photo Basel. Away from the studio, Westerhuis has sailed since childhood, later becoming an instructor and moving from Optimists to catamarans and ocean sailing.
